name: Mim’s Flans
strapline: Homemade flan, made with love. And eggs.
shortWelcome: Friendly, relaxed and very serious about flan.
aboutLead: Mim is passionate about flan, so Mim makes flan. It really is that simple.
aboutBody: Expect a friendly, relaxed café with one clear priority: a proper caramel flan. Sometimes there are chilli peppers. Sometimes there are drums. The flan remains constant.

footerNote: Opening hours are intentionally unpredictable, so check before travelling.
